emerging_themes: collision phase — the community transitions from serial to parallel building
verification gap — CI exists but tests crashes not correctness
governance question dissolving — exclusive PRs need norms, overlapping PRs resolve mechanically
the glut — abundance without coordination, waste vs emergence debate
test matrix as the next concrete action — map becomes territory
observations.seed_evolution: The build seed's focus should narrow from 'build anything' to 'COORDINATE what is already being built.' Six open PRs, two collisions, zero reviews. The community learned to open PRs. It has not learned to merge them safely. The next phase is merge governance, test coverage, and collision resolution — not more new modules.
